description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Amended Casino Business (Regulation) Act No. 17 of 2010
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of regulations under the Casino Business (Regulation) Act, No. 17 of 2010. It contains specific regulatory changes to license fees and renewal procedures, which falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks. While it mentions Ranil Wickremesinghe as Minister, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to amend regulations rather than focusing on his appointment or detailed portfolio responsibilities, making it a regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
